shortDescription: The Czech central bank's (CNB) board sees risks to meeting the bank's 2% inflation target as inflationary overall, the bank said in a presentation after a board meeting on Thursday.The board voted unanimously to leave the main interest rate unchanged at 3.75% at the meeting.
